newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - May 27.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
3,000 STG DEAL AND THE SILENCE OF A MINISTER

Northern Ireland Minister Paul Murphy has refused to give evidence for a group of tenants from the West London estate where he lives. He has instead invoked Parliamentary privilege to avoid going to court as a witness in a case against a property company. He has agreed to accept 3,000 stg if the company wins the case.
BECKETT ERM HINT UNNERVES THE POUND
During a trip to Japan President of the Board of Trade Margaret Beckett hinted that Britain may rejoin the European exchange rate mechanism. The pound fell sharply on Asian markets
PRIMESIGHT POSTS PLAN FOR 15 MLN STG FLOAT

Outdoor advertising company Primesight will be the latest company to take advantage of the booming market when it floats on the stock exchange this summer with an estimated price tag of between 15 and 20mn stg.

Attention is focused on the 11 billion stg sell-off of the power industry in New South Wales, Australia for Britain's Scottish Power, National Power and United Utilities who all failed to make successful bids against Americans.
